title: Anton Bilton's proposed DMT telepathy experiment in Faraday cages

tellings.quote: this guy Anton Bilton >> who was thinking of giving people DMT putting them in adjacent Faraday cages

plain: A man named Anton Bilton had the idea of giving people DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, and putting them in side-by-side Faraday cages, metal enclosures that block radio and other electrical signals, to see whether they could share thoughts. Jesse Michels mentions the plan in passing, in a conversation with a neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore. The point of the cages would be to show that any shared experience could not travel by ordinary signals.
